description:
Turns raw SUMO (vehicle mobility) and OMNeT++/VEINS (cellular network) co-simulation output into a labeled, AI-ready dataset of cellular handover/migration events, for training and evaluating cellular handover / mobility-prediction models in vehicular (V2X) networks.

The workflow chains seven Jupyter notebooks — runnable individually or in one call via a master orchestrator notebook (run_pipeline.ipynb) built on papermill — that take a simulation from raw simulator output to a fully labeled feature matrix: parsing raw SUMO fcd-output XML and OMNeT++ .vec vector files; reconstructing per-vehicle trajectories with lagged position history; aligning SUMO and OMNeT/VEINS vehicle identities (including SUMO's teleportation behavior and OMNeT module-slot reuse, both resolved per-timestep rather than collapsed); merging mobility and radio-network metrics (SINR, CQI, RLC delay/throughput, serving cell) into a single per-vehicle-per-timestep table; and classifying every handover into one of four cases — normal handover, delayed (A-B-C), ping-pong (A-B-A), or no-prior-history — plus a diagnostic-only "unstable" category. An optional seventh notebook produces summary figures and diagnostics.

The workflow is dependency-light (Python ≥3.10, standard scientific-Python stack, plus sed for large-file cleaning), ships with a tiny bundled synthetic example so every notebook runs out of the box with no external data.
name: FUMD-AI Preprocessing Workflow
